authority: harness-specific names following OpenTelemetry unit conventions; not official semantic conventions

benchmark.operations.source: one contraction per sample, reported as sample count and explicit per-worker invocation

propagation.tensor.wires.remaining.source: independent bit-domain projection after support reduction

contraction.mode.dp.work.source: exact ModeBudget.work calls including native kernels

memory_semantics: Peak whole benchmark-process RSS including Python interpreter, imports, and native extension. Not allocations or descendant-process RSS.
timing_semantics: Wall-clock per operation with setup/verification excluded; warmup separate; native pytest-benchmark distribution.
